risk_description: The `87 / 72 / 60` option scores are treated as proof of value or readiness
early_warning_indicator: Deck or decision language drops “provisional,” “design,” or the open gates
mitigation: Keep gate-then-score, evidence labels, rationale, and limitations beside the score
contingency: Withdraw execution language; return to direction-only review

risk_description: An open non-compensating gate is averaged away by perceived strategic upside
early_warning_indicator: Funding, launch, or scale is discussed without authoritative data, control, service, local-right, resilience, rollback, owner, and cost evidence
mitigation: Require signed gate checklist before each later decision
contingency: No-go or narrow scope; a failed critical gate blocks the affected option

risk_description: The `$38.13m` 14-day screen is presented as movable, idle, or surplus cash
early_warning_indicator: Screen value appears in a funded benefit or transfer instruction
mitigation: Keep current validated/funded/recognized cash at `$0`; require VG01–VG05
contingency: Remove cash value and shift work to account-level certification

risk_description: The visibility frame is generalized from 10 purposive accounts to the full 55-account population
early_warning_indicator: Cohort result is reported as a portfolio rate or readiness claim
mitigation: Complete the all-55 census; retain method, selection rule, exclusions, and denominators
contingency: Limit inference to selected accounts; redesign or expand evidence collection

risk_description: `AC0040` enters an unsafe intervention despite being APAC, Payroll, and restricted
early_warning_indicator: Enhanced review, shadow-only flag, or local approval is bypassed
mitigation: Keep enhanced control review and shadow-only treatment; permit documented substitution
contingency: Remove or substitute the account; preserve coverage limitation

risk_description: The 120-record payment frame is interpreted as a prevalence, causal, or enterprise-benefit sample
early_warning_indicator: Sample rates are extrapolated to ACG or used to size automation/labor savings
mitigation: Label purposive case-control design; require reasons, documents, events, criticality, and comparator review
contingency: Stop extrapolation; report only evidence-linked patterns

risk_description: `Completed` controls or 50 exact matches are treated as clean outcomes
early_warning_indicator: Control rows are called settled/error-free or ten deviations are omitted
mitigation: State that `Completed` is supplied status only; review all 10 documented deviations
contingency: Rebuild pairs or limit the comparison; do not claim causal effect

risk_description: A pilot or production change disrupts payroll, tax, refunds, or critical suppliers
early_warning_indicator: Missing service definition, blackout approval, emergency rights, or rehearsed four-hour rollback
mitigation: Keep both charters design-only; approve service/control gates and rollback separately
contingency: No-go, stop, and revert to the approved prior process

risk_description: Cash, P&L, capacity, and risk are added into a false total benefit
early_warning_indicator: One “total value” combines balances, annual fees, hours, or qualitative risk
mitigation: Maintain four non-additive ledgers and Finance recognition gates
contingency: Reject the calculation and rebuild by value type

risk_description: Risk exposure is read as zero because current recognized risk value is `$0`
early_warning_indicator: Management language says “no risk” or uses `$0` as exposure
mitigation: Keep exposure and value `NOT QUANTIFIED`; use `$0` only for the recognized-value ledger entry
contingency: Remove monetization; report control/incident evidence only

risk_description: The `$1.0–$1.5m` ceiling is treated as a cost estimate, approved budget, or spend authority
early_warning_indicator: A return calculation uses the ceiling as cost or a workstream receives an inferred allocation
mitigation: Complete CR01–CR10 with sourced low/base/high timing and ownership
contingency: Do not calculate returns or decide funding; return for staged approval if cost exceeds the ceiling

risk_description: A validation-case output is presented as an investable case
early_warning_indicator: ROI, NPV, payback, funding recommendation, or booked benefit appears before evidence gates close
mitigation: Keep cash/P&L/capacity recognized value at `$0`, risk unquantified, and return metrics unavailable
contingency: Withdraw the investment request and complete value/cost evidence

risk_description: Federated coordination proceeds without global data/control ownership or minimum integration readiness
early_warning_indicator: No accountable global owner, interface plan, or retirement-aware architecture is agreed
mitigation: Time-box owner and architecture decisions; keep modular interfaces and local rights
contingency: Switch to local stabilization with the common data/control minimum

risk_description: Public cases or the Informatica data-quality article are treated as proof of ACG performance or solution fit
early_warning_indicator: External concepts substitute for ACG data, controls, or value evidence
mitigation: Use public material only as context; retain publisher, limitation, and access status
contingency: Remove the unsupported claim or reclassify it as a hypothesis

risk_description: A pilot or production change proceeds inside the confirmed eight-week NA Q4 change-freeze window, or without NA BU CFO sign-off, disrupting peak-season payment routing or approval workflows
early_warning_indicator: A go/no-go, launch date, or evidence-readiness milestone lands inside the eight-week freeze window without a confirmed NA BU CFO sign-off, or the exact freeze calendar remains unconfirmed as the 90-day evidence timebox closes
mitigation: Sequence Phase 4 (later bounded operation) outside the confirmed freeze window regardless of evidence-readiness date; obtain Rachel Kim's (NA BU CFO) sign-off for any North America production change; confirm exact freeze dates with NA BU Finance before locking the go/no-go date
contingency: Hold the pilot at Phase 3 (technical/control rehearsal) until the freeze lifts and sign-off is recorded; do not launch on evidence-readiness alone
owner: NA BU CFO (Rachel Kim) / BU Finance / Shared Services Lead
